_comment: Every screenshot the guides use, retaken by scripts/screenshots.mjs against the app on a fresh docs seed (volt-app/scripts/seed-docs.ts). A shot is a console path, what to wait for, and optionally an element to crop to, elements to hide and clicks to make first. Images land in static/img/screens/<name>.png; guides show them with ![...](/img/screens/<name>.png).

shots.name: account-settings
shots.alt: The Account settings page, with the logo and colours at the top

shots.name: audit-log
shots.alt: The Audit log page listing recent changes, newest first

shots.name: dashboard
shots.alt: The Dashboard: five counts across the top, then the attention list, streams on air, the last seven days and recent output

shots.name: live-streams
shots.alt: The Live Streams board: counts across the top, then one row per running stream with its five gates

shots.name: monitoring
shots.alt: The Monitoring page: severity counts, the alert list and fleet activity

shots.name: multiview
shots.alt: Multiview: the output and viewer location choices, grid size, and a tile per running stream

shots.name: channels
shots.alt: The Channels list: type and status filters, then one row per channel with its type, status and a Start or Stop button

shots.name: channel-status
shots.alt: A channel page: the overall status beside the name, the five gates under it, then the source and output players
shots._why: The docs seed leaves News 24 recorded as running with no encoder behind it, so its page shows real gates: starting just after the API comes up, a failed Server gate with the Diagnose banner after about 90 seconds.

shots.name: radio
shots.alt: The Radio list: status filters, then one row per station with now playing, signal, outputs and status

shots.name: events
shots.alt: The Events list: status filters, list and calendar views, then one row per event with its window, status, recording and replay settings

shots.name: fast-new
shots.alt: The New FAST channel form: name, video or audio, group and time zone

shots.name: epg
shots.alt: The EPG list: one row per channel, station and event guide, with how many programmes it has, how far ahead it is filled and what is next

shots.name: loops-and-fillers
shots.alt: The Loops & Fillers page: the upload area at the top, then the list of loops and slates with a preview, what uses each one, its size and status
shots._why: The docs seed adds a slate (used by News 24) and a loop, so the list is not the empty state.

shots.name: graphics
shots.alt: The Graphics page: counts of templates, setups and what is on air, the four tabs, and the template library with a preview of each

shots.name: captions
shots.alt: The Captions page: the engine for the account at the top, then a card for each output profile with its languages and who uses it

shots.name: formats-and-reframing
shots.alt: The Formats and reframing page: output formats and what to keep in frame on the left, publish targets and when it runs on the right
